# Thunderbird Calendar read-dialog positioning and shared source loading

Positioning code and fixtures do not prove production integration. Calendar commands/views still use legacy `createEventWithDialog`/`createNewEvent` paths; trace `calendar_new_event_command`, month/multiday creation, and existing-event edit routes, passing an originating target only for calendar-surface launches and centering no-target menu/toolbar/keyboard launches. [Task 4]
